reader.reads: Every Latin place and both theses against it; all four places on the first-edition page images.

alexander-gottlieb-baumgarten.aesthetica.note: The place says «et acquisitam; et haec denuo; in docentem et utentem»: the acquired kind is further divided into teaching and using. Both theses say 'and also' without preserving that this second division is of the acquired kind.

summary: Three conceptions are supported by their places; all four places match the pages read. The thesis on natural aesthetics does not preserve the nested division of the acquired kind.
